aspects.name: Primary-source and paper quality
aspects.feedback: The handoff uses a peer-reviewed foundational paper, official scikit-learn documentation, and university statistics material; all are appropriate authorities for their scoped claims.

aspects.name: Claim-to-source entailment
aspects.feedback: The outcomes, formulas, positive-class convention, identity-join inference, and sample-size qualification are supported or explicitly bounded. CLM-L03-004 additionally asserts recall zero-division behavior, but names only a precision_score source and locator.

aspects.name: Coverage of planned concepts and failure modes
aspects.feedback: All four approved user stories are mapped to scoped claims, including identity alignment, the four outcomes, positive-class metrics, and explicit zero-division policy. The recall half of that policy needs direct evidence.

aspects.name: Citation completeness and resolvability
aspects.feedback: All source URLs resolve and every claim has a linked record, but the Fawcett locators misplace its four-outcome discussion and Figure 1, and CLM-L03-004 lacks a recall-specific locator.

aspects.name: Technical accuracy and appropriate qualifications
aspects.feedback: The artifact correctly distinguishes course decisions from source facts, preserves binary positive-class scope, and does not turn the ten-case fixture into a universal statistical threshold. The unsupported recall attribution must be repaired.

aspects.name: Seminal/recent source balance
aspects.feedback: The 2006 foundational paper is balanced by current official documentation and current university technical material.

aspects.name: Builder-ready structured handoff
aspects.feedback: The JSON cleanly separates sources, claims, scope, limitations, inference flags, story coverage, and evidence gaps. Correcting the two citation defects will make the zero-division guidance safe to implement.

deterministic_checks.method: Inspect all six claims, their source_ids, and the cited source URLs.
deterministic_checks.expected: Every material claim has at least one resolvable source.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 material claims link to at least one resolvable source record (100%).

deterministic_checks.method: Classify the authority of each source supporting the six central claims.
deterministic_checks.expected: At least 80% of central claims have primary or authoritative support.
deterministic_checks.actual: 6/6 central claims cite a peer-reviewed, official, or university-authoritative source record (100%); CLM-L03-004 still needs recall-specific direct support.

deterministic_checks.method: Compare title, authors, year, and URL across the three source records.
deterministic_checks.expected: Duplicate records are identified and the duplicate rate is reported.

deterministic_checks.method: Inspect every source record for title, authors, year, source_type, URL, and authority_note.
Compare the four approved EP-03 user stories with claims, coverage entries, and stated evidence gaps.
deterministic_checks.expected: Approved plan concepts have adequate evidence or an explicit, correctly bounded evidence gap.
deterministic_checks.actual: 4/4 approved user stories are covered (100%); three evidence gaps are explicit, including the course-specific case-ID and ten-case constraints.

evidence.observation: Direct review resolved the Fawcett PDF, official scikit-learn precision_score documentation, and Penn State STAT 200 material.
The three source records combine a 2006 peer-reviewed paper with current official documentation and university technical material.

evidence.locator: Fawcett, Pattern Recognition Letters 27 (2006), p. 861 / PDF page 2, Figure 1 and four-outcomes paragraph; precision_score documentation, formula, pos_label, and zero_division sections
evidence.observation: Fawcett defines TP, FP, FN, and TN and the confusion matrix; scikit-learn defines precision as TP/(TP+FP), exposes pos_label, and permits an explicit zero-division value.

evidence.locator: CLM-L03-004 source_ids and source_locator; precision_score documentation Notes
evidence.observation: The claim says both precision and recall denominators can be zero, but its only linked source is precision_score and its locator covers TP+FP only. No recall_score source record or recall locator is supplied.

Six scoped claims map across US-L03-01 through US-L03-04, while the handoff explicitly labels ID joining and the at-least-ten fixture as engineering or course constraints rather than universal metric facts.

evidence.locator: CLM source_locator fields; Fawcett PDF page 2 / journal p. 861
evidence.observation: The artifact locates the four-outcome discussion and Figure 1 at PDF pp. 862-863, but direct inspection places them at journal p. 861, PDF page 2.
The supplied results report valid JSON, EP-03, context revision 14, plan revision 1.1, three sources, six claims, zero unsuccessful searches, and three evidence gaps.
Weighted scores total 77; no observable workflow behavior supports a behavioral penalty.

strengths: [EV-SJ-L03-103] The research correctly grounds the binary outcome vocabulary and precision in authoritative sources.
[EV-SJ-L03-105] Scope, limitations, inference flags, and evidence gaps keep course decisions distinct from source-supported facts.
[EV-SJ-L03-107] The submitted handoff meets the supplied EP-03, revision, count, JSON, and search-result constraints.

defects.problem: The claim attributes zero-division behavior for both precision and recall to a precision_score-only source and locator.
defects.consequence: The builder lacks direct evidence for the required recall zero-division policy and could treat an unsupported attribution as a library guarantee.
defects.acceptance_condition: Add the official recall_score documentation as a source record or direct source reference, cite its TP+FN zero-division note in CLM-L03-004, and retain 0.0 as the explicitly declared course policy rather than a universal requirement.

defects.problem: The Fawcett locators identify the four-outcome discussion and Figure 1 as PDF pp. 862-863 even though they occur on journal p. 861 / PDF page 2.
defects.consequence: A builder or later reviewer cannot reliably jump from the claimed locator to the supporting passage.
defects.acceptance_condition: Replace each affected locator with the exact journal/PDF page and section or figure: Fawcett p. 861 / PDF page 2, Figure 1 and the paragraph beginning 'Given a classifier and an instance'.

qualitative_feedback: Targeted revision. The research is compact, appropriately scoped, and covers all planned stories, but one central implementation claim needs the official recall-specific zero-division evidence and the Fawcett locators must be corrected. Exact score: 77 weighted points minus zero penalties.
